summary: Iteration 11 (Custom Scripts + Terms + User Management + Ticket Detail) tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest PASS covering /api/site/scripts (public), /api/admin/scripts (401 unauth, roundtrip with admin JWT, 403 for analist), /api/admin/users CRUD + zoho_linked + auth_source, /api/admin/roles (all 6 roles + super_admin has 'scripts' perm), /api/admin/activity-log (user.create first record verified), cannot-delete-seed-admin returns 400, and portal ticket detail/threads/reply all require Zoho auth (401). Regression clean: /api/health, /api/reviews approved-only, /api/stats/trust, admin scan-invites gated, portal tasks/milestones/invoice-checkout gated, /api/auth/zoho/login → 307. Frontend: (1) Custom scripts injection verified — after PUT with header='<meta name="pb-inject-test" content="ok">' the home DOM contains that meta tag, and footer HTML comment 'pb-footer-inject-test' appears in <body>. Scripts cleared afterward. (2) /voorwaarden renders page-terms with H1 'Algemene Voorwaarden' and all 14 'Artikel N' headings; /terms with pb_lang=en renders H1 'Terms & Conditions' with all 14 'Article N' headings. footer-link-terms present and navigates to /voorwaarden. (3) /portal/ticket/{fake-id} while unauth renders page-ticket-detail + ticket-back and shows the 'Kon ticket niet openen / Not authenticated with Zoho' error card as spec'd. (4) Admin CMS: /admin/scripts renders cms-scripts with scripts-header-input, scripts-footer-input and scripts-save; save produces success indicator. /admin/users renders cms-users, cms-users-table, cms-activity-log, cms-roles-list; both seed users visible (admin@pearblue.nl super_admin — Niet gekoppeld/unlinked badge; beheer@multibay.eu super_admin — Gekoppeld/linked badge). New user form has all 5 data-testids (user-form-email/name/role/password/submit). All 6 roles are displayed with their permission chips in the roles panel. Activity log shows recent scripts.update and user.create/delete entries.
action_items: No blocking issues. Optional polish: individual role entries in /admin/users roles panel do not appear to expose per-row data-testid like role-row-<key> — testing spec mentioned '6 rows' but implementation renders them as inline chip blocks under cms-roles-list. cms-roles-list itself is present; consider adding data-testid="role-row-<key>" on each of the 6 role blocks if you want per-role deep-linked testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ROLE_PERMS keeps legacy 'admin' key with full super_admin perms (backward-compat). Only super_admin/'admin' can assign/modify super_admin — enforced in create_user & update_user. Good.

server.py seed_admin: on existing record, only upgrades role if it is None or 'admin' — so a super_admin whose role was changed to e.g. beheerder will NOT be forcibly re-upgraded. Correct behavior, but worth documenting.

server.py /api/admin/users list merges db.admins with db.zoho_users; zoho-only users get role=gebruiker & auth_source='zoho'. Nice touch, but note these zoho-only users have no admins-collection doc, so DELETE/PATCH on them will 404. Consider surfacing a hint in UI ('Zoho-only, not manageable here').

zoho_portal.py sendReply builds URL to Zoho Desk correctly with fromEmailAddress from stored orgUser; no injection risk since ticket_id comes from path param and content is JSON body sent to Zoho. Good.
CustomScriptsInjector: injects header/footer HTML via innerHTML — acceptable since only super_admin can write. Ensure the endpoint stays permission-guarded.
TermsPage.jsx correctly toggles NL/EN via LanguageContext; static content, no XSS risks.

seed_data_creation: test_iter11_user@example.com and test_iter11_analist@example.com created and cleaned up within their respective tests. Custom scripts set to injection-test values and restored to empty strings afterward — no test data persisted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 6 roles: super_admin, beheerder, analist, moderator, chat_support, gebruiker. Legacy 'admin' role still allowed via ROLES_WITH_CMS_ACCESS whitelist and has same perms as super_admin. Permissions map is in server.py ROLE_PERMS. seed_admin now upgrades existing admin role 'admin'→'super_admin'. /api/site/scripts is PUBLIC (no auth) — used by CustomScriptsInjector on every page mount. Remember to clear scripts after any test that sets them. /admin/users, /admin/scripts, /admin/roles, /admin/activity-log all require require_permission('users' | 'scripts' | 'users' | 'users').
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 11 scope.
